॥ Om, Jaimini declares that there is no contradiction even in direct (literal) meaning. ॥ 1/2/28 ॥

Words such as “agnī” (fire) and others denote fire and so on. Nevertheless, even in the absence of any other connection, these words are used for the purpose of referring to Brahman, because they are not understood to be used in any other context. This is accepted by Jaimini as being without contradiction. As stated in the Skanda text: “Certain things, delimited by the space within the mind of Vyasa, are used by others, having been made small, just as one uses a house and the like.” Therefore, there is no mutual contradiction among the views of the various schools. ॥ 28 ॥
